## About
Pioneer Auto Body & Repair is a local, family-owned shop with locations in Glenside and Huntingdon Valley. We handle the body work, like collisions, bumpers, dents, scratches and paint, along with the mechanical side: brakes, tires, steering, suspension, engine diagnostics and routine maintenance.
Customers have given us a 4.5 rating across 32 Google reviews. People mention our paint work, our prices and the way we take time to explain the job. If your car needs work, stop by the Glenside shop or give us a call and we'll take a look.

## Services
- Collision repairs and custom painting: Collision repairs and custom painting to get your car back on the road looking right.
- Paint work: A reviewer said the paint work on his truck was excellent.
- Auto repairs and engine diagnostics: From minor auto repairs to engine diagnostics.
- Oil changes and fluid refills: Oil changes and fluid refills to keep your car in good working condition.
- Brakes: Brake repair and replacement.
- Tires: Worn tires repaired or replaced.
- Fleet maintenance: Maintenance for company vehicles to keep your whole fleet running.
- Towing: We provide towing around the clock.

## FAQ
Q: Do you charge for estimates?
A: No. Estimates are free, and our work is guaranteed.

Q: Can you tow my car to the shop?
A: Yes. We offer towing 24/7.

Q: Can you help me with my claim?
A: A reviewer said we helped her with her claim and adjuster. Give us a call and we'll talk it through with you.

Q: Where are you located?
A: We have two shops: one on Mt. Carmel Ave in Glenside and one on Pioneer Rd in Huntingdon Valley.
